chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, is not a tyrant to His servants, nor does He betray in His judgment, nor does He contradict His promise, nor does He break His covenant, nor does He forget His promise, nor does He forget His covenant.
ai.seo_question: What are the key attributes of Allah regarding justice and promises according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq uses this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to ground the Shia doctrine of divine justice (*Adl*) in the Prophet's fidelity, emphasizing that Allah’s covenant-keeping is the foundation of eschatological trust. This highlights the theological principle that God’s attributes of justice and trustworthiness are not merely abstract qualities but active guarantees for the believers' ultimate success.
